summary: Precision Drilling Corp filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its 2026 first quarter unaudited financial results. The filing reports higher revenue of $526 million, up 6% year-over-year, Adjusted EBITDA of $124 million, net earnings of $17 million, and operational updates including share repurchases of $4 million and debt reduction of $25 million during the quarter. This is a routine periodic earnings report with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The registrant's role is as the filer reporting ordinary quarterly results, not as a party to any extraordinary corporate transaction. No deal terms are present as this is not a special situation filing.
